decisions.decision: Postgres becomes the substrate for events, draws and the pile; bd keeps owning beads, Postgres carries bead ids only
decisions.rationale: One queryable store for the relations without replacing bd's Dolt storage and git-backed sync

decisions.decision: Shared/remote topology, one gardener now, actor id on every row from the first migration
decisions.rationale: Team use becomes configuration rather than a schema rewrite

decisions.decision: Writes never block on the network: durable local queue, drains when reachable
decisions.rationale: Built on phase 01's Emit/failure-marker/HealthOf; that work becomes the foundation rather than being discarded

decisions.decision: Pile CONTENT moves into Postgres, not only metadata
decisions.rationale: SQL ranking and joins rather than a boundary crossing; git-diffable history replaced in the same phase as the migration

decisions.decision: UUIDv7 minted at emit for identity, creation order and idempotency
decisions.rationale: Ordering survives the queue drain, where a server sequence would stamp a backlog with the drain time

decisions.decision: Server sequence for ingest order; actor id for provenance
decisions.rationale: UUIDv7 encodes the emitting machine's clock and carries no node field, so it cannot answer either question alone

decisions.decision: Relation graph via Postgres + Apache AGE
decisions.rationale: SQL/PGQ was reverted from PG19 on 2026-09-07; earliest return PG20 ~Sept 2027

context_notes: Milestone v0.2 was opened after a direction change: Postgres for the log, the relational store and the graph, replacing the JSONL substrate. Research is complete and committed (5 docs, 232K). SUMMARY.md proposes: storage seam + test harness, local write queue, convert events, convert draws, convert pile, backup/restore drill, AGE graph. Two research caveats are deliberately unsettled and flagged MEDIUM: pg_upgrade/AGE incompatibility, and AGE Cypher coverage. Recurring theme worth carrying: this project keeps hitting guarantees that report success while doing nothing - a test passing with the code deleted, a health check reporting the opposite of the truth, and a str.replace that matched nothing while its commit message described the change. Verify after writing rather than trusting a clean exit. UPDATE 2026-09-11: requirements are done and committed (f4ca745); the roadmap is the only remaining setup step. .planning/.continue-here.md was deleted here because its instruction ('resume at requirements') became false and a stale checkpoint hard-stops /gsd-progress --next at Gate 1 for no reason. This file is now the sole recovery artifact — keep it accurate.
